description: MainActivity class for an Android app demonstrating network connectivity and data fetching using a Fragment and AsyncTask, with UI interactions and network status handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages network data fetching and UI updates, implementing DownloadCallback interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and prepares network fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for fetch and clear actions.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Starts network download if not already in progress.

methods.name: updateFromDownload
methods.description: Updates UI with downloaded data or error message.

methods.name: finishDownloading
methods.description: Stops ongoing download and cancels network task.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Handles progress updates during network operation.
